items.prompt: What does the writer say about the way the cultures were compared?

options.text: The strength of the concrete made with each culture was measured.
The number of bacterial cells still alive at the end of each run was counted.
The speed at which each culture turned the medium solid was followed.
A different species of bacterium was grown at each of the densities.

items.evidence: Murugan and co-workers cultured the same species at optical densities from 0.1 to 0.5 and tracked how quickly each culture turned the medium into solid carbonate.

distractor_analysis.A: Yer degistirme -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: kendi kendini onaran beton anlatisinda beklenen olcut dayanimdir, ustelik pasajin baska yerlerinde (C/3 egilme dayanimi, H/3 egilmede guclenme) gercekten dayanim olculuyor. Murugan denemesinde olculen sey dayanim degil, coktelmenin hizi.
distractor_analysis.B: Cazip ama yok -- canli hucre sayimi mikrobiyoloji calismasi icin akla ilk gelen olcum; metinde boyle bir sayim hic gecmiyor, yogunluk optik olarak veriliyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Ters yon -- butun yogunluklarda AYNI tur kullaniliyor; secenek denemenin tek degiskenini turlestirerek tersine ceviriyor.

items.scan_note: Kanit G/2. Ayni konunun oteki gecisleri: G/1 ne kadar bakteri eklenecegi sorusu, G/3 en verimli yogunluk ve sureler (bu cumle cumle tamamlama paketinin 5. kalemine ait, dokunulmadi), G/4 daha yuksek yogunlugun etkisi (bu paketin 2. kalemi). Karbonat coktelmesinin kimyasi F/2-4'te.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says that Murugan and co-workers cultured the same species at a range of optical densities and tracked how quickly each culture turned the medium into solid carbonate.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: What does the writer say about the sixty octopuses collected for the study?
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kanit cumlesi artik alistirma havuzuna ait olmayan A02 pasajina aitti (test havuzu sizintisi).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem bastan yazildi ve A13'un G paragrafina baglandi. ILK capa G/3'tu; paketler arasi tarama o cumlenin cumle tamamlama paketinin 5. kalemince de kullanildigini gosterince (bir kanit cumlesine bir soru kurali, daha kisitli tip kalir) kalem G/2'ye kaydirildi ve bastan yazildi. Yeni dogru cevap denemenin kendi olcutu: coktelme hizi. Genel kultur ('beton calismasinda dayanim olculur' -- ustelik pasajin baska yerlerinde gercekten olculuyor) A secenegine capalandi ve yanlis. Konumsal duzen icin dogru harf C korundu; en uzun secenek B, yani yanlis.
yeniden_uretim.recete_sinamasi: Kok ve secenekler yeniden, metinsiz okundu: bir beton-bakteri denemesi icin dort olcut de makul, hatta dunya bilgisiyle en beklenen olan A. Tek aday cikmadi. GECTI.

items.prompt: What does the writer say about using still denser cultures?

options.text: They raised the speed of the reaction without improving output per cell.
They raised output per cell without changing the speed of the reaction.
They slowed the reaction down once a certain density of cells had been passed.
They gave the highest yield of any density tested.

items.evidence: Higher concentrations raised the raw rate but not the yield per cell.

distractor_analysis.B: Ters yon -- A secenegiyle bilerek ayna simetrisinde yazildi: hiz ile hucre basina verim yer degistiriyor. Iki secenek de ayni olcude 'incelikli' gorundugu icin, pasaji okumamis bir aday ikisi arasinda hicbir gerekce bulamaz.
distractor_analysis.C: Cazip ama yok -- bir esikten sonra yavaslama metinde hic gecmiyor; doygunluk sezgisi tasidigi icin akla yatkin goruyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Yer degistirme -- en verimli sonucu araligin ortasi veriyor (G/3, optik yogunluk 0.4); secenek en yuksek yogunlugu en iyi sonuca bagliyor, yani 'daha cok bakteri daha iyidir' genel sezgisini yanlisa capaliyor.

items.scan_note: Kanit G/4. Yogunluk-verim iliskisi G/2 ve G/3'te de geciyor, ama oradaki cumleler aralik ile en verimli noktayi anlatiyor; 'daha yuksek yogunluk' ifadesi yalniz G/4'te. I/4 ise butun calismalarda en iyi karisimin en cok onarim maddesi tasiyan karisim olmadigini soyluyor -- ayni fikrin pasaj capinda tekrari, ama bu kalemin kaniti degil.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says that higher concentrations raised the raw rate but not the yield per cell.

items.prompt: Which TWO things does the writer say about the mortar bars seeded with mould spores?

options.text: The two moulds turned out to affect the bars differently.
Their bending strength rose by between a third and two fifths at first.
Their bending strength roughly doubled while the crystals were forming.
They were weaker in bending than untouched bars from the start.
Their pores were emptied of carbonate crystals as the moulds spread.
A fifth or more of their bending strength was gone by the twelfth month.
They were seeded with the moulds only after cracks had appeared.

items.evidence: For the first six months the colonised bars grew stronger in bending, by 35 to 40 per cent, as carbonate crystals filled their pores. By twelve months the same bars had given up 21 to 27 per cent of that strength.

distractor_analysis.A: Cazip ama yok -- iki kuf birlikte kullaniliyor ve aralarinda hicbir karsilastirma yapilmiyor; 'iki tur farkli davranmistir' beklentisi tamamen okurdan geliyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Kapsam kaydirma -- B ile ayni cumleyi hedefleyen buyukluk celdiricisi: artis yuzde 35-40, yani iki katina cikma degil. Iki secenek de ayni bicimde yazildigi icin ayrim ancak sayiyi okumakla yapilir.
distractor_analysis.D: Ters yon -- ilk alti ayda kuflenmis cubuklar egilmede GUCLENIYOR. Bu secenek genel kulturun capalandigi yer: kufun malzemeyi bastan bozdugu herkesin bildigi bir sey oldugu icin pasaji okumayan aday buraya cekiliyor.
distractor_analysis.E: Ters yon -- H/3 karbonat kristallerinin gozenekleri DOLDURDUGUNU soyluyor; secenek ayni cumleyi tersine ceviriyor.
distractor_analysis.G: Cazip ama yok -- sporlar cubuklara bastan ekiliyor; catlak sonrasi asilama metinde hic gecmiyor, ama kendi kendini onaran beton anlatisina yakistigi icin akla yatkin goruyor.

items.scan_note: Kanit H/3 ve H/4. Ayni deneyin baska yonleri H/1 (canli ajanin malzemeye zarar verebilecegi), H/2 (recine orani ve kosullar -- bu cumle cumle tamamlama paketinin 6. kalemine ait, dokunulmadi) ve H/5 (once muhurleyip sonra sokme) cumlelerinde; I/2 fungal sonuclari 'biyolojik ajanin kendi gundemi vardir' diye ozetliyor. Bu kalem yalniz H/3 ile H/4'e dayaniyor; H paragrafindan baska kalem uretilmedi.
items.explanation: Paragraph H says the bars grew stronger in bending by 35 to 40 per cent over the first six months, and that by twelve months they had given up 21 to 27 per cent of that strength.

items.prompt: What does the writer say the team did with the results they took from the papers?

options.text: They compared the printed figures with the files that the authors eventually supplied.
They rechecked a few dozen results chosen at random from each paper.
They set aside any result taken from a paper with no material available.
They recomputed more than a thousand results that had been reported as significant.

items.evidence: The team extracted one thousand one hundred and forty-eight results reported as statistically significant and recomputed every one, looking for cases in which the printed probability did not follow from the figures beside it.

distractor_analysis.A: Yer degistirme -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: bir makaleyi denetlemenin ham veriyle karsilastirmak demek oldugu yaygin bir varsayim. Oysa D/1-3 tam tersini kuruyor: bu denetim hic ham veri olmadan, makalenin kendi ic tutarliligindan yapiliyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Kapsam kaydirma -- secim rastgele degil ve kapsam birkac duzine degil; anlamli bildirilen sonuclarin TAMAMI yeniden hesaplaniyor. Ornekleme sezgisi tasidigi icin akla yatkin goruyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Ters yon -- verisi paylasilmayan makaleler disarida birakilmiyor; E/4 hatalarin dortte ucunun tam da o makalelerden ciktigini soyluyor, yani onlar analizin merkezinde.

items.scan_note: Kanit D/4. Yeniden hesaplamanin sonuclari E (kirk dokuz tutarsizlik), F (anlamliligi bozan on vaka) ve G (esige yakinlik) paragraflarinda; yontemin mantigi D/2-3'te. Bu kalem yalniz D/4'teki islemin kendisine ve olcegine dayaniyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the team extracted one thousand one hundred and forty-eight results reported as statistically significant and recomputed every one.

items.prompt: What does the writer say about the results that failed the recalculation?

options.text: They were divided fairly evenly between overstatements and understatements.
They came to about four in every hundred of the results checked.
They were almost all found in papers whose files had been supplied.
They amounted to roughly a quarter of the significant results.

items.evidence: Forty-nine of those results, roughly four in every hundred, did not add up.

distractor_analysis.A: Ters yon -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: aritmetik hatalarin rastgele, yani iki yone esit dagilmasi beklenir. E/2 tam tersini soyluyor: neredeyse her vakada basili olasilik kendi rakamlarinin gerektirdiginden KUCUK, yani daha etkileyici.
distractor_analysis.C: Ters yon -- hatalarin yaklasik dortte ucu verisini paylasmayan makalelerden geliyor (E/4); secenek yonu tersine ceviriyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Kapsam kaydirma -- oran yuzde dort civari; secenek bunu yuzde yirmi bese cikariyor. Iki sayi da 'kucuk bir azinlik' gibi durdugu icin ayrim yalniz metinden yapilir.

items.scan_note: Kanit E/1. Ayni paragrafin devami hatalarin yonunu (E/2) ve nerede toplandigini (E/3-4) anlatiyor; F on vakayi, G esige yakinligi ayri ayri ele aliyor. Bu kalem yalniz E/1'deki orana dayaniyor, E paragrafindan baska kalem uretilmedi.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says that forty-nine of the results checked, roughly four in every hundred, did not add up.

items.prompt: Which TWO points does the writer make about the ten inconsistencies of a different order?

options.text: The recalculated figure took away the significance the paper had claimed.
All ten of them appeared in a single journal.
They were the only inconsistencies the team was unable to explain.
Their authors corrected them once the team had pointed them out.
Not one of them came from a team that had handed over its files.
They were smaller in size than the other discrepancies found.
They arose where the size of the sample had been reported wrongly.

items.evidence: In these the recalculated probability crossed the conventional threshold of significance altogether, so that the paper announced a significant finding which its own reported numbers did not support. Every one of the ten came from a paper whose material had not been shared.

distractor_analysis.B: Cazip ama yok -- iki dergi secildigi B/2'de soyleniyor, ama on vakanin dergilere dagilimi hic verilmiyor.
distractor_analysis.C: Kapsam kaydirma -- bu on vaka aciklanamaz olduklari icin degil, sonucu devirdikleri icin ayri tutuluyor (F/4).
distractor_analysis.D: Cazip ama yok -- genel kulturun capalandigi ikinci yer: bilimsel yayincilikta hatanin bildirildiginde duzeltilmesi beklenen davranistir. Metinde duzeltme, geri cekilme ya da yazarlarla temas sonrasi bir islem hic gecmiyor.
distractor_analysis.F: Ters yon -- bu on vaka 'farkli bir mertebede', yani sonucun kendisini deviren buyuk tutarsizliklar; E/4 zaten buyuk sapmalarda yogunlasmanin daha da agir oldugunu soyluyor.
distractor_analysis.G: Cazip ama yok -- yeniden hesaplama test istatistigi, ornek buyuklugu ve olasilik ucgenine dayaniyor (D/2), ama hatanin kaynagi olarak yanlis bildirilen ornek buyuklugu gosterilmiyor; yontemi bilen bir okur icin akla yatkin bir mekanizma oldugu icin cekici.

items.scan_note: Kanit F/2 ve F/3. On vakanin yorumu F/4'te (calismanin en keskin sonucu), daha genis hata tablosu E'de, esige yakinlik ayrimi G'de. Cift cevapli kalem oldugu icin F paragrafindan baska kalem uretilmedi.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says that in these ten cases the recalculated probability crossed the threshold of significance altogether, and that every one of the ten came from a paper whose material had not been shared.

items.prompt: Which TWO things does the writer say about the force directed sideways?

options.text: It was recorded only in the closing moments of stance.
It was larger on concrete than on either of the softer coverings.
It was the largest of the three directions of force measured.
It was greater on turf than on concrete through part of the middle of stance.
Runners widen their stride a little in order to keep their balance on soft ground.
It was greater among the heel-landers than among the other group.
A covering that gives way does so unevenly under a foot that never lands square.

items.evidence: Between the twentieth and thirty-eighth per cent of stance, and again in the last two per cent, that sideways force was larger on artificial grass than on concrete. A soft covering deforms unevenly beneath a foot that is never placed perfectly square, so the ground yields slightly more in one direction than in another, and the runner spends force resisting a drift that a rigid floor would never allow.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- yan kuvvet basma evresinin tamami boyunca kaydediliyor; fark yalniz iki pencerede (yuzde 20-38 ve son yuzde 2) ortaya cikiyor. Secenek olcumu farkin gorundugu yere daraltiyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Ters yon -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: sert zeminin daha buyuk kuvvet uretmesi beklenir. Yan kuvvette olculen tam tersi; sertligin ustunlugu yalniz ileri itiste ve yalniz son yuzde altida (F/5) gecerli.
distractor_analysis.C: Cazip ama yok -- uc kuvvet yonunun buyuklukleri birbiriyle karsilastirilmiyor; kuvvet plakasinin uc yonde olcum yaptigi D/2'de soyleniyor, siralama yok.
distractor_analysis.E: Cazip ama yok -- ikinci mekanizma secenegi olarak bilerek yazildi ki 'aciklama bicimindeki tek secenegi sec' sezgisi calismasin. Ustelik E/1-5 adim geometrisinin degismedigini soyluyor, yani adim genisletme metinle celisiyor.
distractor_analysis.F: Yer degistirme -- iki kosucu grubunun farkli etkilenmesi H/4-5'te, eklem torklari icin soyleniyor (on ayak basanlar ayak bileginde, topuk basanlar dizde); yan kuvvet icin boyle bir ayrim verilmiyor.

items.scan_note: Kanit G/2 ve G/4. Yatay/frenleme kuvvetinin zaman pencereleri F'de, eklem torklari H'de, degismeyen aci ve sertlik degerleri E'de. Cift cevapli kalem oldugu icin G paragrafindan baska kalem uretilmedi.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says the sideways force was larger on artificial grass than on concrete between the twentieth and thirty-eighth per cent of stance, and explains that a soft covering deforms unevenly beneath a foot that is never placed perfectly square.

items.prompt: What does the writer say makes the effect of the ground hard to establish outdoors?

options.text: Runners tend to avoid the hardest surfaces on a long route.
The wind, the temperature, the wetness of the ground and the light all change too.
The pace, the slope, the shoes and the weather change along with the surface.
Stride length and time on the ground cannot be recorded away from a laboratory.

items.evidence: Outdoors the surface never varies on its own: speed, slope, footwear and weather vary with it, and any difference in the runner could belong to any of them.

distractor_analysis.A: Cazip ama yok -- kosucularin zemin secmesinden hic soz edilmiyor; A/2 yalnizca bir antrenman rotasinin uc ayri zemini kesebilecegini soyluyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Kapsam kaydirma -- C ile ayni bicimde, dort ogeli ve disarida kosarken gercekten degisen seylerden kurulu bir liste; ama metnin saydigi dort etken bunlar degil. Iki liste birbirini otelediginden 'liste bicimindeki secenegi sec' sezgisi ise yaramiyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Cazip ama yok -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: bu olcumlerin laboratuvar donanimi istedigi disaridan makul gorunur. Metnin verdigi gerekce donanim degil, degiskenlerin birlikte degismesi; ustelik olcumler icin gereken duzenek D paragrafinda anlatiliyor, imkansizlik olarak degil.

items.scan_note: Kanit A/4. Ayni paragrafta A/2 bir rotanin uc zemini kestigini, A/5 sorunun bu yuzden ic mekana tasindigini soyluyor; C/3 ayakkabinin, D/3 hizin nasil sabitlendigini anlatiyor. Bu kalem yalniz A/4'teki etken listesine dayaniyor ve A paragrafindan baska kalem uretilmedi.
items.explanation: Paragraph A says that outdoors the surface never varies on its own: speed, slope, footwear and weather vary with it, so any difference in the runner could belong to any of them.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kalem bastan yazildi ve A16'nin A/4 cumlesine baglandi. Dogru cevap metnin kendi sectigi dort etken; ayni bicimde ikinci bir dort ogeli liste (B) yazildi ki bicim dogruyu ele vermesin. Genel kultur ('bu olcumler ancak laboratuvarda yapilir') D secenegine capalandi.

items.prompt: How do the authors sum up what their measurements show?

options.text: Runners adjust the shape of their stride to suit the hardness of the ground.
Softer ground lowers the total force that passes through the leg.
The findings hold for running at any speed and on any surface.
The stride keeps its shape while the forces beneath it are rearranged.

items.evidence: What the study establishes is narrower and firmer than a general rule about surfaces: when the ground under a runner changes in hardness, the visible geometry of the stride stays where it was, while the forces underneath it are quietly redistributed.

distractor_analysis.A: Ters yon -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: yumusak zeminde adimin kisaldigi ya da degistigi yaygin bir inanis. Calismanin ilk bulgusu tam tersi (E/1-4): kalca, diz ve ayak bilegi acilari uc zeminde ayirt edilemiyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Cazip ama yok -- toplam kuvvetin azaldigi hic soylenmiyor; olculen sey kuvvetin yeniden dagilmasi, buyuklugunun dusmesi degil. Yumusak zeminin 'daha az yuk' anlamina geldigi sezgisi yuzunden cekici.
distractor_analysis.C: Ters yon -- I/2-3 tam tersini soyluyor: tek hiz, duz zemin, on bes metre ve deneycilerin sectigi ayakkabi; viraj alan ya da cok daha hizli kosan biri icin sonuc gecerli olmayabilir.

items.scan_note: Kanit I/4. Ayni paragrafin I/2-3 cumleleri calismanin sinirlarini sayiyor; degismeyen aci ve sertlik degerleri E'de, yeniden dagilan kuvvetler F, G ve H'de ayrintiliyor. Bu kalem yalniz I/4'teki ozet cumleye dayaniyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says that when the ground changes in hardness the visible geometry of the stride stays where it was, while the forces underneath it are quietly redistributed.

items.prompt: What does the writer say about the way the panels were taken out of the water?

options.text: They were brought up at regular three-day intervals.
Every retrieval produced a pair of samples.
Collection appears to have gone on for about a month.
The last of them were left down until growth stopped increasing.

items.evidence: Panels were brought up on the first, third, sixth, ninth, twelfth and fifteenth days, two frames at a time so that every retrieval produced a duplicate.

distractor_analysis.A: Kapsam kaydirma -- gunler 1, 3, 6, 9, 12 ve 15; ilk aralik iki gun, sonrakiler uc gun. Duzenli bir tasarim beklendigi icin secenek akla yatkin goruyor, ama listeyi okumadan elenemez.
distractor_analysis.C: Kapsam kaydirma -- pencere on bes gun; secenek bunu iki katina cikariyor. J/3 de on bes gunun kisa bir pencere oldugunu soyluyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Cazip ama yok -- toplama takvimi bastan sabit; buyumenin durmasina bagli bir olcut hic gecmiyor, ama deney tasarimi olarak makul goruyor.

items.scan_note: Kanit E/1. Ayni paragrafin devami ornegin nasil yikanip kazindigini (E/2-3) ve elektron mikroskobu icin ayrilan yuzeyleri (E/4) anlatiyor; toplama gunlerinin sonuclari I'de, su kosullarinin her toplamada olculmesi F/1'de geciyor. Bu kalem yalniz E/1'e dayaniyor ve E paragrafindan baska kalem uretilmedi.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says the panels were brought up two frames at a time so that every retrieval produced a duplicate.

items.prompt: What does the writer say about the variety of bacteria across the fortnight?

options.text: It reached its highest point at the sixth day, fell back, then climbed again.
It appears to have risen steadily from the first day of the trial through to the last.
It was at its greatest on the final day of the trial.
It changed very little once the third day had passed.

items.evidence: One order dominated the first day's surfaces and a different one the third; by the sixth day several groups shared the space and variety reached its highest point, fell back by the ninth day, then rose again by the fifteenth.

distractor_analysis.B: Kapsam kaydirma -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: bir yuzey kolonilesirken cesitliligin duzenli olarak artmasi beklenir. Metnin verdigi egri duz degil: tepe, dusus ve yeniden yukselis.
distractor_analysis.C: Yakin ama eksik -- on besinci gunde cesitlilik yeniden yukseliyor, ama en yuksek noktanin altinci gun oldugu ayni cumlede soyleniyor.
distractor_analysis.D: Ters yon -- ucuncu gunden sonrasi tam da en hareketli bolum; ustelik I/3 zamanin her seyi yeniden duzenledigini soyluyor.

items.scan_note: Kanit I/4. Ayni paragrafta I/2 orneklerin malzemeye gore degil gune gore kumelendigini, I/5 Proteobacteria'nin duzenli azalisini soyluyor; kutle farklari G'de, dizileme sayilari H'de. Bu kalem yalniz I/4'teki cesitlilik egrisine dayaniyor ve I paragrafindan baska kalem uretilmedi.
items.explanation: Paragraph I says variety reached its highest point by the sixth day, fell back by the ninth day, then rose again by the fifteenth.

items.prompt: What practical point do the authors make at the end?

options.text: Titanium should be chosen for intake surfaces wherever it is affordable.
Cleaning is best done before the sixth day, while variety is still rising.
When a surface is cleaned may count for as much as what it is made of.
A wider range of materials would show the same absence of sorting.

items.evidence: Within those limits the practical message is straightforward: a plant that cleans an intake surface is choosing a moment in a predictable sequence, and the moment may matter as much as the metal.

distractor_analysis.A: Yakin ama eksik -- genel kulturun capalandigi secenek: 'en dayanikli malzemeyi sec' hem sezgisel hem de G/1'deki kutle siralamasiyla (titanyum en az birikim) desteklenir gorunur. Ama kapanis paragrafi boyle bir tavsiye vermiyor; verdigi mesaj malzeme degil zamanlama uzerine.
distractor_analysis.B: Cazip ama yok -- belirli bir temizlik gunu hicbir yerde onerilmiyor; I/4'teki cesitlilik egrisinden turetilmis gibi durdugu icin cekici.
distractor_analysis.D: Ters yon -- J/2 tam tersini soyluyor: daha genis bir malzeme yelpazesi, bu ucunde gorulmeyen malzemeye gore ayrismayi yine de ortaya cikarabilir.

items.scan_note: Kanit J/4. Ayni paragrafta J/2 malzeme sayisinin, J/3 on bes gunluk pencerenin sinirlarini anlatiyor; malzemenin kutleye etkisi G'de, zamanin toplulugu belirlemesi I'de. Bu kalem yalniz J/4'teki pratik mesaja dayaniyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph J says a plant that cleans an intake surface is choosing a moment in a predictable sequence, and that the moment may matter as much as the metal.
